description: KVClient performance exported by the UCM vLLM connector (default ucm: prefix): request/key throughput, client and transport latency, and errors. Select the intended vLLM scrape job. View switches between model-level aggregation and Engine/Worker series. Node-task histograms pool all node samples within each Worker; individual nodes cannot be selected. Durations are in seconds. Model and Worker selectors use the same UCM metric discovery as the Connector dashboard; selecting a model does not imply that KVClient metrics are available.
